treatment_summary.value: Brief CPAP after birth; physical therapy begun at 9-10 months; feeding and occupational therapy; hippotherapy, a body suit and a gait trainer; an eye gaze computer for communication. No drug treatment reported.

disease_label_as_stated.value: Rett syndrome (RTT; MECP2) and autosomal-recessive succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency (SSADHD) (dual diagnosis)

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Clinical exome sequencing (Fulgent Diagnostics), ordered for global developmental delay of unknown etiology, confirmed the dual diagnosis at 17 months; urine organic acids at 18 months showed elevated GHB (not quantified); GHB in dried bloodspot 673 uM (control range 0-78 uM; cutoff 63 uM). Discussion: loss of hand function, loss of speech, regression in ambulation and hand stereotypies meet diagnostic criteria for classic RTT.
